bio.text: Nick Coffey is the Democratic nominee for Oklahoma Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Jon Echols.
He is a former federal prosecutor who, according to Oklahoma Voice, spent seven years as an Oklahoma City-based assistant U.S. attorney.

Oklahoma Voice reported at his October 2025 campaign launch that he lives in Oklahoma City, is a fifth-generation Oklahoman and a graduate of the University of Oklahoma College of Law, and that it was his first political campaign.

sources.title: Former federal prosecutor Nick Coffey to face off against John Echols in AG race - News9.com
Former federal prosecutor runs for Oklahoma attorney general as a Democrat
